description: This file defines an interface ICustomStorageInterface for custom storage operations within Orleans grain storage, particularly focusing on reading state and applying deltas with version control.

classes.name: ICustomStorageInterface
classes.description: Interface for custom storage operations involving state reading and delta application in Orleans grains with version management.

methods.name: ReadStateFromStorage
methods.description: Reads the current state and version from storage, returning a key-value pair with version number and state object.

methods.name: ApplyUpdatesToStorage
methods.description: Applies a list of delta updates to storage if the current version matches the expected version, returning true on success.
